title: NurseryRhymeScene
description: Single scene unit for a nursery rhyme video storyboard

duration_seconds.description: Scene duration. Target 4–8s. Max 30s for extended chorus loops.

lyrics_line.description: Exact lyric line(s) sung during this scene. Max 12 words.

chorus_flag.description: True if this scene is part of a chorus repeat. Used for loop detection.

story_beat.description: Narrative function of this scene in the story arc.

educational_goal.description: What toddler learns or reinforces in this scene. Can be null for pure story beats.

emotion.description: Primary emotional tone for this scene. Drives character facial expressions.

name.description: Character name from the Gigi's Playhouse universe

role_in_scene.description: What the character is doing in this scene

expression.description: Facial/body expression for animation or image prompt

location.description: Primary scene location. Drives background asset selection.

background_description.description: Detailed background visual description for asset generation. Include time of day, colors, key props.

camera_direction.description: Camera direction. Used for animation/editing instructions.

action.description: Primary action happening in the scene. 1–2 sentences, present tense.

prop_list.description: List of props visible in this scene. Each prop should be simple and toddler-recognizable.

visual_prompt.description: Full prompt for AI image generation. Should include style, characters, action, setting, color palette, and mood. Avoid copyrighted references.

thumbnail_candidate.description: True if this scene has strong thumbnail potential: clear emotion, expressive character, readable at small size.

caption_text.description: Text overlay or closed caption for this scene. Usually matches lyrics_line.

transition_type.description: Transition INTO this scene from the previous scene.

repeatable_loop_flag.description: True if this scene can be looped without jarring the viewer. Used for chorus scenes and background loops.

audio_cue.description: Any non-lyric audio note: sound effect, pause, instrumental break, etc.

color_palette_hint.description: Dominant colors for this scene. Max 4. Used for visual consistency across batch.

notes.description: Production notes for animators or editors. Optional.
